snippets.text: Industry survey 2026: roughly 120,000 mid-market retailers (50-999 employees) operate in the EU.
18% of EU mid-market retailers used AI in customer support in 2026, up from 9% in 2024.
Retailers cite 24/7 coverage and multilingual customer support as the top reasons to adopt AI support.
Four vendors target EU mid-market retail customer support with AI-first offerings; two are US-based competitors.
Analyst note: the addressable base is closer to 95,000 mid-market retailers once franchise duplicates are removed.
Typical competitor pricing is per resolved conversation, between $0.60 and $1.20.
Pilot data: an AI-resolved support ticket costs about $0.04 in model usage with prompt caching.
Fully loaded human cost per support ticket in EU retail averages $4.10.
Integration and QA typically add 20-30% on top of model usage cost in year one.
EU AI Act: customer-facing chatbots must disclose that users are interacting with AI (transparency obligations).
GDPR: large-scale processing of customer conversations will likely require a data protection impact assessment (DPIA).
Data residency: many EU retailers require EU data processing; confirm regional processing options with the provider.
